notes.text:
This update for avahi fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2024-52615: wide-area DNS uses constant source port for queries and can expose the Avahi-daemon to DNS spoofing
  attacks (bsc#1233421).

notes.text: A flaw was found in Avahi-daemon, which relies on fixed source ports for wide-area DNS queries. This issue simplifies attacks where malicious DNS responses are injected.
